title: The Rev. Edward Coleridge
dates: (1800-1883)
---

master at Eton, from 1867 Vicar of Mapledurham

His first wife Mary Keate (d. 1859) was the daughter of Dr Keate, headmaster of Eton;  he married secondly (1862), Mary Caroline Bevan (1822/3-1907).

He was tutor to his nephew J. C.

Patteson; recipient of sums from CMY from 1853, perhaps on Patteson\'s behalf; and a keen supporter of missionary work.
